Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group, so use 280 for the roster sheet. I replied to Nadia in the #strategic-pod thread.

He first posted 300 in his July 1 update. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout, and 280 is the active production roster as of Jul 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280.

That figure is from July 1, so it may have changed since.
